subject: Merging methylation calls from both strands on a single methylRaw object

messages.author: e1978c4dfcca8a28
messages.subject: Merging methylation calls from both strands on a single methylRaw object
parts:
Hello

Is there a way to merge the mehtylation calls from both strands in a single methylRaw object?
The reason that I'm asking is that I have RRBS data from mouse, for which I wan to know the coverage for each CpG site in a certain subset (specifcally, CpG sites located within CpG islands that contaion a TSS).
 While I understand that the methylation on both strands should be symmatrical, I get different coverage when I examine calls from both strands on the same site, for example:

GRanges object with 2 ranges and 3 metadata columns:
      seqnames               ranges strand |  coverage     numCs     numTs
         <Rle>            <IRanges>  <Rle> | <integer> <numeric> <numeric>
  [1]     chr1 [36568636, 36568636]      + |         9         0         9
  [2]     chr1 [36568637, 36568637]      - |         4         0         4
 
I could of course turn my methylRaw object into a methylRawList object and then destrand it using unite(myobj, destrand=TRUE).
But I was wondeirng if there is more striaghtforward way to do this, or alternativlity if there if I'm missing something
and what I'm tring to do doesn't make sense.

And help/insihgts will be appreciated.

Thanks in advance
Dolev Rahat

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Merging methylation calls from both strands on a single methylRaw object
parts:
Hi,
unite() with destrand=TRUE argument invokes an unexported function to merge methylation calls on both strands of a CpG, so there is no function you can directly use. Below is more of a hack, you shouldn't use it unless you completely understand what is going on.

# mr is methylRaw object
df.mr=methylKit:::.CpG.dinuc.unify(getData(mr))
new.obj=new("methylRaw",df.mr,sample.id=m...@sample.id,assembly=mr@assembly,context=mr@context,
resolution="base")
